say:1:1710357001:1.text: ... Alaine and Countess Caloren? What are you doing here?
say:1:1710357001:1.source_cn: ……阿莱茵馆长？还有……凯洛伦夫人？你们在做什么？

say:3:1710357002:1.text: *Sobbing*... Princess! Dura above, what a terrible day this is!
say:3:1710357002:1.source_cn: 呜呜……公主殿下！艾雅啊！这到底是什么倒霉日子！

say:4:1710357003:1.text: I got robbed by a monkey this morning, and when I finally returned to my residence...
say:4:1710357003:1.source_cn: 上午在庆典上被那只该死的猴子抢了包受了惊吓，好不容易回...

say:5:1710357004:1.text: I was dragged to this horrible place!
say:5:1710357004:1.source_cn: 结果眼睛一闭一睁，就到这种可怕的地方来了！

say:6:1710357005:1.text: You must've been frightened, Countess Caloren. Now that we're together, I'll keep you safe.
say:6:1710357005:1.source_cn: 夫人受惊了。请放心，既然汇合了，我会护你周全。

say:7:1710357006:1.text: Alaine, are you alright? The armors could be dangerous; please keep your distance.
say:7:1710357006:1.source_cn: 阿莱茵馆长？您没事吧？那些东西很危险，请不要靠近。

say:9:1710357007:1.text: Oh, it's Princess Peggy. Greetings. I'm fine.
say:9:1710357007:1.source_cn: 哦，是佩吉殿下啊。日安。我没事。

say:10:1710357008:1.text: Though this strange phenomenon defies my understanding, it doesn't disturb me much.
say:10:1710357008:1.source_cn: 准确地说，虽然这种瞬间传送现象不合常理，但我的心绪并没...

say:11:1710357009:1.text: ... You're remarkably composed. Were you also taken here from home?
say:11:1710357009:1.source_cn: ……您还真是冷静。您也是从家里来到这里的吗？

say:12:1710357010:1.text: No, Your Highness. When it happened, I was deep inside the Evergreen Exhibition—in a special gallery closed to the public.
say:12:1710357010:1.source_cn: 不，殿下。事发时，我正在冬青展览馆的最深处——一间不对...

say:14:1710357012:1.text: Yes. I was doing routine maintenance on a set of <style="highlight">ancient magic armor</style>.
say:14:1710357012:1.source_cn: 是的。我正在对馆藏的那套<style=highligh...

say:15:1710357013:1.text: The runes on the armor flared up suddenly. As I was preparing to record the data... I found myself here in the next instant.
say:15:1710357013:1.source_cn: 那套铠甲上的符文突然产生了异常反应，我正准备记录数据…...

say:16:1710357014:1.text: Please look at these armors. They resemble the one in my collection, but their cores are entirely different.
say:16:1710357014:1.source_cn: 殿下，请看！这里的铠甲，虽然外形与我馆藏的那套有些相似...

say:17:1710357015:1.text: While the one in my collection is self-propelled by runes, these armors appear to be empty shells, controlled by magic from an external source.
say:17:1710357015:1.source_cn: 馆藏的那套是依靠内部铭文实现自驱的高阶魔法造物；而眼前...

say:18:1710357016:1.text: I need to find out more about their differences. Just let me take a closer look...
say:18:1710357016:1.source_cn: 这是两种不同的使用方式，我想弄明白原理。只要让我靠近研...

say:19:1710357017:1.text: Take a closer look?! That's crazy, Alaine!
say:19:1710357017:1.source_cn: 靠近研究？！你疯了吗？！阿莱茵！

say:20:1710357018:1.text: Alaine, I fully understand your curiosity, but it's too dangerous to get near the armors when we know almost nothing about them.
say:20:1710357018:1.source_cn: 阿莱茵馆长，我非常理解您的求知欲，但现在情况不明，贸然...

say:21:1710357019:1.text: You're the Vice President of the Evergreen Conservatory and a leading figure in the academic community.
say:21:1710357019:1.source_cn: 您是冬青学会的副会长，是耀光学术界的中流砥柱。

say:22:1710357020:1.text: You're a vital asset to our empire, and we can't let anything happen to you here.
say:22:1710357020:1.source_cn: 学会不能失去您这位优秀的学者。若是您折损在这里，那将是...

say:23:1710357021:1.text: Fair enough. My safety, as a repository of knowledge, is indeed crucial. I'll go with you.
say:23:1710357021:1.source_cn: 好吧。与充满了不确定性的现场研究相比，保存研究者这一载...

say:24:1710357022:1.text: Good call. Countess Caloren, can I count on you to keep Alaine from wandering off again?
say:24:1710357022:1.source_cn: 明智的选择。凯洛伦夫人，请抓紧阿莱茵女士，千万别让她再...

say:25:1710357023:1.text: You can trust me, Your Highness. I won't let go of her hand until we're out of here!
say:25:1710357023:1.source_cn: 放心吧，殿下！除非离开这里，否则我绝不会松手的！
